tools.name: create_event
tools.rich: Create a single, one-off event on one date. For an event that repeats, use the recurring-event tool.

params.name: title
params.rich: Event title as the attendees will see it.

params.name: date
params.rich: The date, YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: start_time
params.rich: Local start time, 24-hour HH:MM.

params.name: duration_minutes
params.rich: Length in minutes, 5 to 480.

params.name: attendees
params.rich: Email addresses to invite.

tools.name: create_recurring_event
tools.rich: Create an event that repeats every week on one weekday.

params.name: title
params.rich: Event title as the attendees will see it.

params.name: weekday
params.rich: Day of the week it repeats on.

params.name: start_time
params.rich: Local start time, 24-hour HH:MM.

params.name: duration_minutes
params.rich: Length in minutes, 5 to 480.

tools.name: list_events
tools.rich: Every event on one date, with ids, times and titles. For a span of several days use the multi-day listing tool.

params.name: date
params.rich: The date, YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: find_free_slots
tools.rich: Open slots of at least the given length on one date, between 08:00 and 18:00.

params.name: date
params.rich: The date, YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: duration_minutes
params.rich: Length in minutes, 5 to 480.

tools.name: update_event
tools.rich: Move or rename an existing event by its id. Only the fields given change.

params.name: event_id
params.rich: The id returned by the day listing or the title search.

params.name: new_title
params.rich: Replacement title.

params.name: new_start_time
params.rich: New local start time, HH:MM.

tools.name: cancel_event
tools.rich: Delete an existing event by its id and notify attendees.

params.name: event_id
params.rich: The id returned by the day listing or the title search.

tools.name: add_attendee
tools.rich: Add one invitee to an existing event by its id. To take someone off an event use the invitee-removal tool.

params.name: event_id
params.rich: The id returned by the day listing or the title search.

params.name: email
params.rich: The invitee's email address.

tools.name: set_reminder
tools.rich: Remind the owner a number of minutes before an existing event.

params.name: event_id
params.rich: The id returned by the day listing or the title search.

params.name: minutes_before
params.rich: Minutes before the start, 1 to 1440.

tools.name: get_event
tools.rich: Full details of one event by its id.

params.name: event_id
params.rich: The id returned by the day listing or the title search.

tools.name: search_events
tools.rich: Events whose title contains the query, across all dates.

params.name: query
params.rich: Text to look for in titles.

tools.name: list_events_between
tools.rich: Every event from a first date through a last date, with ids, dates, times and titles; up to 14 days. For a single day use the day listing tool.

params.name: start_date
params.rich: The first date, YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: end_date
params.rich: The last date, YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: convert_time
tools.rich: Convert a clock time on a given date from one time zone to another. Not for creating an event or finding free time.

params.name: time
params.rich: The time in the source zone, 24-hour HH:MM.

params.name: date
params.rich: The date, YYYY-MM-DD, because daylight saving can change the result.

params.name: from_timezone
params.rich: The time zone the time is in, such as a city or a zone name.

params.name: to_timezone
params.rich: The time zone to convert to, named the same way.

tools.name: rsvp_event
tools.rich: Answer an invitation you received to an existing event, by its id. Not for adding someone else to an event.

params.name: event_id
params.rich: The id returned by the day listing or the title search.

params.name: response
params.rich: Your answer to the invitation.

tools.name: remove_attendee
tools.rich: Take one invitee off an existing event by its id. The event itself stays.

params.name: event_id
params.rich: The id returned by the day listing or the title search.

params.name: email
params.rich: The email address of the invitee to remove.
